calculation.description: When lagged cross-asset daily return dispersion is elevated relative to its trailing 60-session median, rank assets by lagged five-session reversal normalized by lagged 20-session realized volatility. Higher values indicate stronger candidate rebound after a recent shock. All inputs are shifted to prevent look-ahead.
